name: Zoledronic acid
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Zoledronic acid is a bisphosphonate excreted unchanged by the kidneys and can cause kidney failure. For the 4 mg oncology dose (most PH products), the US label reduces the dose by creatinine clearance (CrCl) from 60 mL/min down to 30 and does not recommend treatment in severe impairment; serum creatinine must be checked before every dose and treatment withheld for kidney deterioration. The 5 mg osteoporosis product (Reclast) is contraindicated below CrCl 35.
kidney_function_basis: Label uses Cockcroft-Gault CrCl (mL/min): >60, 50–60, 40–49, 30–39; severe impairment <30. Reclast: CrCl <35.
chip: Dose by CrCl; SCr before each dose

bands.recommendation: Myeloma or bone metastases, CrCl >60: 4 mg IV over at least 15 minutes every 3 to 4 weeks. Hypercalcemia of malignancy: 4 mg (no adjustment if serum creatinine <4.5 mg/dL). Reclast 5 mg: no adjustment at CrCl ≥35 (labels). Check serum creatinine before each dose.

Myeloma or bone metastases: CrCl 50–60, 3.5 mg; 40–49, 3.3 mg; 30–39, 3 mg (label Table 1). Withhold for kidney deterioration (creatinine rise of 0.5 mg/dL from normal, or 1 mg/dL from abnormal baseline) until within 10% of baseline. Reclast 5 mg: contraindicated below CrCl 35.

Myeloma and bone metastases: not recommended in severe renal impairment (trials excluded serum creatinine above 3.0 mg/dL). Hypercalcemia of malignancy: consider only after weighing risks and benefits. Reclast 5 mg (osteoporosis, Paget's): contraindicated at CrCl <35 mL/min.

hd: Not recommended in severe renal impairment (label); not studied in dialysis. Specialist decision (e.g., oncology with nephrology input).
pd: Not recommended in severe renal impairment (label); not studied. Specialist decision.
crrt: Not recommended in acute kidney injury; Reclast is contraindicated with acute renal impairment (label).
dialyzable: Not stated in label. Low protein binding (unbound 60% to 77%), but most of the dose not excreted is bound to bone.
monitoring: Serum creatinine before every dose; calcium, phosphate, magnesium; hydration before infusion (no diuretic before hypovolemia is corrected). Dental examination (osteonecrosis of the jaw). Thigh or groin pain (atypical femur fracture).

adult: 62 of 72 PH products are 4 mg (powder or 4 mg/5 mL concentrate); 2 are 5 mg/100 mL (osteoporosis). The tiles mix both rules: oncology dose table and Reclast CrCl <35 contraindication.
Label does not define 'severe renal impairment' for oncology; mapped to CrCl <30 (the bottom of its dose table).
Reclast citation is the alternate label stored in data/drugs/labels/zoledronic-acid.json.
